name: trail-rows
title: Trail Rows
description: The rows of a long trail or tree, shared by commit-history and git-tree: virtual-rows in document flow by default, or UI SDK's virtualizer with findable layers so find in page reaches rows that aren't rendered.
docs: `useTrailRows({ count, estimate, getKey, text, findable })` returns `segments` (rows, with a `top` when `absolute`, and gaps that hold the space of the rows between), `anchor` (the rows' parent, in flow), `setScroller` (the scroller), `measure`, `textSlot`, `pin`, `scrollToIndex` and `reveal`. Without `findable` it is `useVirtualRows` from `virtual-rows`, rows in document flow; with it, `useFindableRows` puts rows on UI SDK's virtualizer, absolutely positioned in a box `height` px tall, and builds its findable layers once the page is idle, so find in page reaches rows that aren't rendered by the pieces `text(index)` returns. `useInstanceState(instance)` reads a UI SDK primitive instance's state with `useSyncExternalStore`. `commit-history` and `git-tree` install it; you rarely need it directly.
